These filters do not remotely match the quality of the filter that came with my Essick Air M1201.  The humidifier would run all night and not use any water - the filters are cheaply made and do not wick up the water as needed.  After going through three of these wicks in a single week, I broke down and bought the AirCare wicks (made by Essick Air) and the difference is between night and day. I have been refilling the bottle every 6 hours of so...just like when the unit was new.  The Crucial Air filters were a waste of money.

These did NOT work in my Kenmore. I ran on high for 12 hours and used very little water, which is highly unusual. Just for kicks, I replaced the filter and tried again, with the same result. I was finally able to locate the actual Kenmore brand filter and the unit is back to normal. These filters were a complete waste of my money.
